specs.title: Audit 1: Layout Overflow and Responsiveness across all viewports
Audit 2: Complete Interactive Element Inventory & State Checks
Audit 3: Design Studio CREATE, MODIFY, EXPLAIN & Target Selection
1. Natural Language Design geometry preview accurately renders geometry, supports, loads, and CAD grid
2. Analysis History pagination footer adheres to design standards
3. New Analysis evidence-card copy provides accurate, neutral explanation
4. Issue Resolution Assistant is hidden by default and docks in bottom-right corner when opened
5. Right sidebar tabbed workspace cleanly toggles between Tools and Design with AI
6. Construction and Structural tools use 3-column grid with uniform 48px tile height
7. Sequential AI proposal generation, application, and model mutation
8. Model mutation and Undo support restores previous geometry state
9. Revision conflict handling rejects stale proposals gracefully
1. Dashboard: semantic selectors and buttons retain existing behavior
2. Accessibility: canvas floating controls and header actions have explicit accessible names
3. P1 Fix: AnalysisResultsPanel viewport management, lower joints clickability, expand/minimize states, and pan/zoom
